title: National Investments Company
description: ninv.com National Investments Company (NIC) is one of Kuwait's leading investment firms, founded in 1987 and listed on Boursa Kuwait as NINV, managing 4.3 billion dollars in assets across four segments: investment, treasury, real estate and asset management. Led by CEO Fahad Abdul Al Mukhaizim, it employs 161 people across its Kuwait City headquarters and Dubai DIFC office. In 2026 it reported net profit of KWD 10.6 million for the first 9 months with AUM reaching KWD 1.4 billion and total return of 545 percent since 2019 versus 122 percent for the Kuwait index. It executed the Trolley General Trading IPO with 15.2x oversubscription and the Ali Alghanim Sons IPO, the largest in Kuwait in over a decade. Recognized by Euromoney as Best Investment Bank in Kuwait for Equity Capital Markets three consecutive years. Its strategy targets becoming a leading regional investment firm by 2029 through international expansion, alternative investments and strategic global partnerships.
